title: Tom in the City
text:
Tom is new in the city. He has a map of the city in his hand. The map shows the library, the bus station and the shop. The library is next to the shop.

Tom needs a bus timetable. The bus to the library leaves at 9:30. It stops near the bus station. Tom takes the bus every Saturday.

questions.text: What does Tom have in his hand?
What time does the bus to the library leave?
Why does Tom need a timetable?
options: To know when the bus comes

questions.text: Why is Tom probably going to the shop after the library?
options: Because the shop is next to the library
Because the shop is in another city
Because the shop is closed on Saturday
Because the bus station is the shop

vocabulary.definition: a drawing that shows the places in an area
a list that shows when buses or trains leave and arrive

paragraph_translations: Tom jest nowy w mieście. Ma w ręku mapę miasta. Mapa pokazuje bibliotekę, dworzec autobusowy i sklep. Biblioteka jest obok sklepu.
Tom potrzebuje rozkładu jazdy autobusów. Autobus do biblioteki odjeżdża o 9:30. Zatrzymuje się w pobliżu dworca autobusowego. Tom jeździ autobusem w każdą sobotę.
